grade.reference_answer: > Hi! I am Hanson. I am 11 years old. Last Sunday, I **played** badminton with my father. My father is good at playing it, so I wanted to beat him very much. We played for an hour. The score was 18-19, and I was behind. I took a deep breath and tried my best. Finally, I won 21-19! I was so happy and excited. It was really an enjoyable sport moment.
